name: Innovate Inventory Management System
author: workinnovate

sections.description:
The Innovate Inventory Management System WordPress plugin simplifies and streamlines product management for e-commerce businesses.
This comprehensive tool allows you to manage your products, stocks, and SKUs efficiently, ensuring seamless inventory control.

Key Features:
– Parent-child product management: link child products to a parent product.
– Automatic stock reduction when a parent product is sold.
– Parent product automatically marked out of stock when any child product is out of stock.
– Accurate and real-time inventory tracking.

This ensures reliable and transparent stock management for WooCommerce stores.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce plugin must be installed and active.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress “Plugins” screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How do I set up the plugin?

Install and activate WooCommerce, then activate this plugin. A setup wizard will guide you through the initial configuration.

What happens if a child product goes out of stock?

If a child product goes out of stock, the parent product will also be marked as out of stock to reflect accurate inventory.

Is this plugin compatible with my WooCommerce version?

This plugin requires WooCommerce. It has been tested up to WordPress 6.7 and PHP 7.4+. Check your versions for compatibility.
